architecture.engine: bundled Python: pymavlink, NumPy, SciPy, PyArrow
architecture.ipc: versioned framed stdio via narrow Rust commands
architecture.default_network: offline except explicitly configured LAN sources / user-opened references
platforms: macOS x64 if supported by release target matrix
architecture.version_policy: Select and lock tested versions during packaging spike; pin firmware adapters, parser and algorithm revisions.
architecture.connection_service: Separately supervised, explicitly commissioned transport/fan-out with recorder isolation; never synthesize controlling GCS heartbeat.
architecture.repair_broker: Narrow signed elevated helper; typed plan-bound host changes; audited apply/verify/rollback

non_negotiables: Original logs and protected tune baselines are immutable.
Every number/finding traces to source hash, instance, field, time scope, parser and rule version.
Missing/unsupported/stale is not zero, healthy or a physical fault.
Raw, measured post-filter and simulated post-filter data are distinct.
No VIBE-to-FFT inference; no current-only PID prescription.
No automatic aircraft parameter writes, flight commands, log erase or firmware update.
No unrelated vehicle, boot epoch, battery monitor or flight merging.
No required cloud upload or user-installed Python/Node runtime.
No dummy data outside explicitly labeled synthetic demo/test context.
No silent numerical threshold copied across firmware/hardware profiles.
No disruptive host/GCS/radio repair when aircraft state is armed or unknown.
No firewall disable, indiscriminate port ranges, arbitrary shell commands, bridge/NAT or default-route changes as a generic repair.
No snapshot is falsely labeled atomic or complete solely because a file exists.
No filename/date/sysid-only automatic evidence association; hard contradictions override ranking.
No log download while armed or armed-state freshness is unknown.
No recorder/router heartbeat substitution that masks loss of the controlling GCS.
QGC one-way forwarding is not a bidirectional parameter/log request channel.
Historical flight analysis always retains its own effective-configuration evidence.

entities.name: AircraftProfileVersion
entities.required_contents: Aircraft ID; board/firmware identity; physical motor map; ESC instance mapping evidence; motors/props/battery; calibration status; hardware changes; limits and their provenance.

entities.name: FlightRecord
entities.required_contents: Canonical analysis record for exactly one ArmedInterval; FlightSession is a deprecated design alias, not another grouping.

entities.name: SourceManifest
entities.required_contents: Original name/location; SHA-256; byte size; device and software identity; acquisition method; start/end clocks; parser version; success/partial/error status; warnings.

entities.name: SignalSchema
entities.required_contents: Source message/field; physical quantity; raw and engineering units; scaling provenance; sensor/ESC/system/component instance; expected and observed cadence; sentinels.

entities.name: Sample / event
entities.required_contents: Source ID; boot epoch; source sequence/message offset; raw time; time domain; normalized time if valid; value or null; quality flags.

entities.name: TimeAlignment
entities.required_contents: Source and target clocks; anchor pairs; affine/piecewise transform; offset/drift; fit residuals; uncertainty; confidence; user adjustments and provenance.

entities.name: MetricResult
entities.required_contents: Algorithm/version; interval and phase; value/unit; count and time coverage; exclusions; uncertainty; source/field references; interpretation limits.
entities.unknown_policy: Unknown configuration permits eligible descriptive metrics only; empty interval references require explicit unknown state and reasons; mixed intervals must be partitioned or labeled.

entities.name: Finding
entities.required_contents: Rule/version; severity; evidence quality; confidence; observation; competing hypotheses; evidence intervals; next action; expected result; parameter applicability; retest criteria.
entities.unknown_policy: Unknown configuration permits eligible descriptive metrics only; empty interval references require explicit unknown state and reasons; mixed intervals must be partitioned or labeled.

entities.name: ParameterSnapshot
entities.required_contents: Immutable captured/reconstructed or reference-only state; only flight-supported evidence can seed an EffectiveConfigurationInterval.

entities.name: Experiment / issue
entities.required_contents: Baseline and candidate; one functional change; confounders; planned success criteria; repetitions; results; open/investigating/retest/resolved history.

entities.name: CollectionJob
entities.required_contents: Per-adapter state/progress; resumable transfer position; retries; chosen flight grouping; missing-data consequences and recovery instructions.

entities.name: ParameterProposal
entities.required_contents: Unapplied candidate; never eligible as the observed base_snapshot_id of actual-flight metrics.

rules.name: Source identity and schema
rules.inputs: VER/MSG/FMT/FMTU/UNIT/MULT; manifest
rules.algorithm_requirement: Identify firmware, schema, vehicle and source before semantic decoding.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Unknown identity/units => partial assessment; never silently apply another build's scale.

rules.name: Recording completeness
rules.inputs: DSF, cadence, parser status, byte ranges
rules.algorithm_requirement: Measure missing/corrupt/truncated intervals and logger rejection deltas.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Mark affected results partial; missing messages do not establish healthy operation.

rules.name: Clock validity
rules.inputs: Boot/sample/UTC/receive clocks; anchors
rules.algorithm_requirement: Split epochs and estimate transform with residual/uncertainty.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No cross-source ordering or causal claims below clock uncertainty.

rules.name: Vibration exposure
rules.inputs: VIBE by IMU and axis; phase
rules.algorithm_requirement: Quantiles, time exposure and longest exceedance at 30/60 m/s² guidance bands.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Separate persistent airborne vibration from takeoff/landing impacts.

rules.name: Clipping episodes
rules.inputs: Version-correct clipping counters
rules.algorithm_requirement: Reset/wrap-aware increments per sensor, preserving unknown initial history.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Unknown event timing across a gap; mechanical review before tuning persistent clipping.

rules.name: IMU health and disagreement
rules.inputs: IMU health/error/rate/temp, sensor/lane selection
rules.algorithm_requirement: Track new errors, sensor changes and paired disagreement.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Different orientation/scale or missing health data blocks sensor-fault attribution.

rules.name: Spectrum eligibility
rules.inputs: GYR or valid ISBH/ISBD raw samples
rules.algorithm_requirement: Validate scale, timing, continuity, sample rate, pre/post identity and Nyquist.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Reject VIBE-as-FFT, missing batches and unsupported provenance.

rules.name: Noise orders and notch candidate
rules.inputs: Gyro spectra, RPM lineage, filter chain/params
rules.algorithm_requirement: Identify persistent ridges/orders; model attenuation and delay using matching firmware.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No numeric notch candidate with unknown RPM scale, stale data, aliasing or filter topology.

rules.name: Rate/attitude tracking
rules.inputs: ATT/ANG/RATE, targets, phase
rules.algorithm_requirement: Error, lag, bias, quantiles, valid-step or identified response with uncertainty.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No universal tuning score; invalid excitation or saturation suppresses gain inference.

rules.name: PID contribution diagnosis
rules.inputs: PID terms/flags, gyro/output spectra, target/error
rules.algorithm_requirement: Evaluate I accumulation/recovery, D noise association and limiter activity.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Large I/D terms alone do not prove windup or wrong gains.

rules.name: Actuator authority
rules.inputs: Motor mapping, RCOU, MOTB/PID flags, output protocol
rules.algorithm_requirement: Match limit episodes and output demand to tracking loss.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Output number is not physical thrust; absent protocol/limits blocks saturation claims.

rules.name: Energy and phase power
rules.inputs: Primary physical battery V/I, counters, phase
rules.algorithm_requirement: Signed trapezoidal integration; gap-aware coverage; compare valid counters.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Never sum aggregate/component duplicate monitors; partial Wh must remain labeled partial.

rules.name: Battery limits and voltage demand
rules.inputs: Calibrated pack/cell signals, chemistry, configured thresholds
rules.algorithm_requirement: Evaluate applicable voltage/current/thermal limits and dwell with actual source selection.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No universal 12S chemistry limits or cell-balance inference from pack voltage.

rules.name: Efficiency and endurance scenario
rules.inputs: Power, usable energy, mass/conditions, motion
rules.algorithm_requirement: Matched hover/cruise metrics and scenario estimates with reserve/uncertainty.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No causal PID-energy claim from one flight or unsupported nominal capacity.

rules.name: ESC channel freshness
rules.inputs: Mapped ESC/RPM/electrical/thermal records
rules.algorithm_requirement: Completeness and sample-age checks per expected instance/channel.
rules.abstention_or_limit: RPM-only presence cannot establish temperature/current coverage.
spec_sections: 15  ESCs, motors, airframe and power distribution

rules.name: Motor asymmetry and response
rules.inputs: Command, RPM/current/temp, phase/CG/wind
rules.algorithm_requirement: Detect persistent matched-condition differences and abrupt response changes.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Preserve allocation/wind/calibration alternatives; no unique fault cause from imbalance alone.
spec_sections: 15  ESCs, motors, airframe and power distribution

rules.name: GNSS quality
rules.inputs: GPS/GPA and optional receiver diagnostics
rules.algorithm_requirement: Fix/accuracy/cadence/correction transitions and estimator impact.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No position trust or interference-source conclusion from satellites/jam indicator alone.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Estimator consistency
rules.inputs: Lane-specific XKF/NKF status, innovation tests, sensor sources
rules.algorithm_requirement: Identify excursions, resets, timeouts, lane/aiding changes.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Use exact transformed metric semantics; a ratio crossing is not the complete failsafe logic.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Heading/compass interference
rules.inputs: MAG, yaw innovations, source/orientation and current
rules.algorithm_requirement: Controlled heading/field comparisons and current-associated residuals.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No copied offsets or interference percentage derived from an unrelated regression.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Altitude/trajectory response
rules.inputs: PSC/CTUN, mode/mission/offsets and frames
rules.algorithm_requirement: Compare requested, shaped target and achieved motion with reset/frame handling.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Mission upload/ACK is not execution or completion.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Power rails and resets
rules.inputs: POWR/MCU, board topology, error/reset evidence
rules.algorithm_requirement: Review new flags and measured rail/temperature excursions.
rules.abstention_or_limit: An abrupt log ending is not proof of brownout; low-rate data misses transients.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Scheduler and logging load
rules.inputs: PM/RTDT/DSF, loop and logging config
rules.algorithm_requirement: Properly scaled load, long-loop counts, memory and dropped-log episodes.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Do not use a universal raw Load or rail threshold.
spec_sections: 16  Navigation, heading, altitude and controller health

rules.name: Control path / failsafe reconstruction
rules.inputs: RCIN/RCI2/MAVC/MODE/ERR/MSG/TLOG/ACK and configured timeouts
rules.algorithm_requirement: Reconstruct per-system request, receipt, acceptance and observed response.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No RF-loss attribution from sequence gaps; ACK is not physical completion.
spec_sections: 17  Radio, GCS, joystick and video troubleshooting

rules.name: RF diagnostics and capture health
rules.inputs: Both radios raw/normalized records with verified units/windows
rules.algorithm_requirement: Separate API failure, missing samples and RF observations; deduplicate known rolling history.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Unknown timestamp/units => raw archive only; expired unrecorded history is unrecoverable.
spec_sections: 17  Radio, GCS, joystick and video troubleshooting

rules.name: GCS/video observation path
rules.inputs: Supported host/player/camera/network measurements
rules.algorithm_requirement: Correlate freezes/drops/load and control-stream health with clock uncertainty.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Ping or video file alone does not measure glass-to-glass latency.
spec_sections: 17  Radio, GCS, joystick and video troubleshooting

rules.name: Configuration and baseline diff
rules.inputs: Actual per-flight snapshots plus parameter timeline
rules.algorithm_requirement: Version-aware changed/added/removed values and hardware/calibration-specific fields.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Never overwrite protected baselines or assume final parameters applied to the whole flight.

rules.name: Experiment result and regression
rules.inputs: Repeated matched baseline/candidate flights and acceptance criteria
rules.algorithm_requirement: Flight/segment-aware comparison with uncertainty and multi-objective constraints.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No success label with confounded conditions or unacceptable tracking/thermal/health regression.

rules.name: Observer freshness and alert state
rules.inputs: Source time progression, receipt age, recorder/engine status
rules.algorithm_requirement: Per-channel staleness, dwell/hysteresis, clear/recur and post-flight reconciliation.
rules.abstention_or_limit: A stale dashboard is not an all-clear; acknowledgement is not resolution.

rules.name: Address and route suitability
rules.inputs: Native interface, route, source-address and endpoint observations
rules.algorithm_requirement: Evaluate actual path including prefix, default route, VPN and return path.
rules.abstention_or_limit: A secondary IP cannot bridge a physical gap; unknown next hop blocks route repair.

rules.name: Firewall policy evidence
rules.inputs: Effective policy, receiver, interface, source and observed traffic
rules.algorithm_requirement: Separate explicit block from incomplete visibility; prepare narrow rule only for diagnosed need.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No-packet silence alone is not a proven firewall fault.

rules.name: UDP ownership and delivery
rules.inputs: Socket owners, arrival/cadence and MAVLink/RTP parser evidence
rules.algorithm_requirement: Identify intended receiver and distinguish arrival from valid decode.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Never seize GCS socket or use reuse flags as a tee.

rules.name: Video pipeline and runtime
rules.inputs: Actual loaded GCS runtime, codec, plugins and frame counters
rules.algorithm_requirement: Locate transport/codec/parser/decoder/buffering failure and retest fresh frames.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Gst-launch in another runtime does not prove GCS health; no unsupported end-to-end latency claim.

rules.name: Radio destination and service path
rules.inputs: Configured and observed radio endpoints, source interface, firmware
rules.algorithm_requirement: Detect wrong fallback/learned destination or unsupported air-side management path.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Do not teach a new destination with a probe; configuration writes can reboot.

rules.name: Repair eligibility and verification
rules.inputs: Reviewed typed plan, baseline, flight state, effective policy
rules.algorithm_requirement: Apply idempotently through broker, verify target and Internet, rollback owned objects.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Armed/unknown state, stale plan or unsupported writer blocks disruption.

rules.name: Session lifecycle integrity
rules.inputs: Fresh autopilot state, identity, boot/time evidence and journal
rules.algorithm_requirement: Create persistent interval identity; handle rearm, replay, gap and late start.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Armed is not airborne; silence is not disarmed.

rules.name: Required recorder coverage
rules.inputs: Per-source freshness, disk and durable checkpoint records
rules.algorithm_requirement: Start before arming and preserve gaps/restart evidence across source failures.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Do not claim historical RF recovery or continuous capture across sleep.

rules.name: GCS and transport capability
rules.inputs: MP/QGC process, path, socket and routing observations
rules.algorithm_requirement: Select proven adapter and observer/request capabilities; validate failsafe transparency.
rules.abstention_or_limit: QGC forward-only path cannot request params/logs; no spoofed control heartbeat.

rules.name: Postflight retrieval eligibility
rules.inputs: Fresh disarm, inventory, source identity, closure and throughput
rules.algorithm_requirement: Retrieve/resume verified completed sources; estimate SD fallback and pause on rearm.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Growing source/prefix remains partial; no invented ID-to-filename mapping.

rules.name: Parameter capture completeness
rules.inputs: Component-scoped entries/count/type/raw transfer and firmware
rules.algorithm_requirement: Validate full exposed set, bounded missing-entry retries, table stability and EOF.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Complete collection is not atomic capture.

rules.name: Parameter freshness at arm
rules.inputs: Preflight interval, changes, reboot/gap and postflight readback
rules.algorithm_requirement: Attach best eligible evidence; reconcile with matched onboard observations.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Stale/postflight-only data cannot be backdated to arming.

rules.name: Effective configuration timeline
rules.inputs: PARM/PARAM observations, readback and reboot metadata
rules.algorithm_requirement: Separate observed/configured/effective state; bracket uncertain changes; segment metrics.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No exact causal timing when change activation is unobserved.

rules.name: Flight-artifact match
rules.inputs: Hardware/provenance, boot/events, time-series anchors and contradictions
rules.algorithm_requirement: Evaluate deterministic many-to-many source-span association; preserve candidate evidence.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Hard contradiction or indistinguishable candidate prevents automatic verification.

rules.name: Manual retrieval verification
rules.inputs: Observed remote inventory/path and imported content
rules.algorithm_requirement: Generate exact evidenced request or SD-folder scan; validate import before resolving.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Filename, date or sysid alone cannot resolve the request.

rules.name: Comparable configuration change
rules.inputs: Matched phases, params, mass, battery, wind and calibration
rules.algorithm_requirement: Compute eligible effect sizes and uncertainty with trade-offs and confounders.
rules.abstention_or_limit: No single-flight causal claim or energy gain from sensor-scale changes.

rules.name: Metric configuration provenance
rules.inputs: Metric scope, parameter interval, field/units and firmware
rules.algorithm_requirement: Link each metric to applicable settings and correct throttle/control quantity.
rules.abstention_or_limit: Unknown scale/effective interval blocks precise interpretation, not all descriptive analysis.

acceptance_families.scenarios: Duplicate bytes, duplicate filenames with different bytes, two vehicles in one TLOG, multiple flights in one file, wrong profile and unknown firmware.
Older/newer VIBE formats; fixed-point scale applied once; missing/sentinel values; corrupt/truncated records; unknown units; very large input.
FC reboot, counter wrap, PC wall-clock jump, drift, invalid UTC, delayed TLOG delivery and radio time with unknown epoch.
Known constant/ramp power; long gaps; negative current; partial windows; battery-monitor duplication; clipping counters starting nonzero/resetting.
Known sine/noise, missing batch, irregular sampling, aliasing, pre/post provenance; valid/rejected steps; saturation and low-excitation cases.
One missing ESC/RPM/temperature channel; stale values; unsupported sensor; partial log; enough data to plot but insufficient to recommend.
Busy port, armed aircraft, growing log, byte gap, disconnect/resume, changed remote log, bad radio JSON, failed poll, overlapping RF windows, disk full.
Inspect every outbound controller message; no arming, mode, mission, parameter writes or log deletion. Read-only source failure cannot stop the controlling GCS.
Fresh install, offline mode, crash/restart, profile revision, immutable baselines, report reproduction, keyboard/200% zoom and clear synthetic data.
Recorder overload, UI crash, stale telemetry, duplicate timestamps, app sleep/resume, alert clear/recur and post-flight revision of a hypothesis.
Representative Cube and H7 logs; four mapped APD ESCs; both SkyPulse responses; actual GCS forwarding; SIYI capability probe.
Matched trials improve known synthetic metrics; confounded payload/wind/time scope blocks causal improvement claims.
Separate NIC, shared DHCP NIC, VPN overlap, wrong source/default route and Internet preservation.
Declined elevation, stale plan, policy block, rollback, concurrent edits, crash and armed/unknown state.
UDP socket contention, wrong codec, runtime shadowing, missing plugin, no ICMP and RTSP-media split.
Late start, arm/rearm, bench test, replay, reboot, heartbeat loss and same-sysid aircraft.
Non-atomic downloads, missing updates, changing counts, type/encoding/EOF, stale state and pending reboot.
Wrong2028 dates, reusedIDs, multiplefiles/flights, wrongmanualBIN, missingUID, SDfilename unknown.
Both GCS active, switch midflight, one-way QGC, UI/recorder/router failure and real control-loss visibility.
Current-sensor calibration, payload/wind/logging-rate confounders and typed/semantic hashes.

revision_summary: Adds network/stream diagnosis and reversible repairs, automatic session recording, full parameter evidence, MP/QGC integration, verified BIN/TLOG linking and configuration-to-performance insights.
repository_scope: flight-insights app repository; Q22 aircraft documents remain separate
baseline_alias_policy: Preserve earlier Brian-named files/bytes and aliases; display FACt names; never synthesize missing baseline.

session_orchestration.identity: Random persistent UUID independent of time; local aircraft-scoped number for display only.
session_orchestration.capture_session_relation: One capture session has many armed intervals; armed interval has zero or more airborne segments; files associate many-to-many via source spans.
session_orchestration.unknown_state_policy: Keep recording; do not infer disarm from silence, transfer bulk logs, or apply disruptive repair.
session_orchestration.rearm_policy: Create distinct armed interval; suspend existing bulk transfer; keep prior collection queued.
session_orchestration.late_start_policy: Mark unknown start and missing preflight evidence; reconcile later without fabricating prior capture.
session_orchestration.concurrency: Watcher remains active while prior intervals settle/collect/reconcile/await SD. normal_flow is one interval lifecycle, not a global blocking loop. Shared bulk transfers pause on current arming or unknown state.

parameter_evidence_contract.atomicity: Not guaranteed by parameter protocol or packed FTP; preserve capture interval.
parameter_evidence_contract.capture_policy: Full preflight and postflight reads while disarmed; passive observations and BIN reconciliation; bounded retries; no flight-time full bulk read.
parameter_evidence_contract.effective_boundary: Observed variable value is distinct from subsystem activation; preserve pending reboot and uncertain change intervals.
parameter_evidence_contract.typed_value_policy: Lossless numeric representation with observed/inferred type provenance; do not hash rounded UI text.
parameter_evidence_contract.duplicate_policy: Accept and deduplicate identical retransmissions; reject conflicting values/key-index mappings; unresolved gaps stay partial.

association_contract.verification_requirement: Identity and interval checks plus corroboration under a versioned rule; no competing indistinguishable candidate or unresolved contradiction.
association_contract.manual_sd_policy: Exact filename only from observed listing/validated mapping; otherwise select SD folder and content-match candidates.
association_contract.revisions: Append association/manifest history; never overwrite raw bytes or prior report provenance.

network_contract.repair_scope: Host interface addresses, verified destination routes, narrowly scoped firewall and supported GCS settings only; radio writes separate explicit grounded workflow.

q22_profile.gstreamer_mp_baseline: System-wide MinGW; inspect actual loaded path/version
q22_profile.firewall_policy: Wired interfaces, Any profiles, local address unrestricted, confirmed remote10.0.0.2; scope destination UDP ports/actual receiver.

network_contract.dual_nic_policy: Keep Internet gateway/DNS; no drone default gateway; no bridging/NAT needed for directly attached non-overlapping subnets.
network_contract.unknown_udp_policy: No expected packets is inconclusive until discriminating evidence; socket or allow rule alone not proof.
network_contract.safety_precondition: Fresh known disarmed state or explicit grounded commissioning evidence for the selected topology; never silence==disarmed.
network_contract.rollback_policy: Owned objects only, concurrency-safe, local timed rollback for severing host operations; remote radio recovery not guaranteed.

gcs_contract.both_running: Select proven intended connection or ask once; never arbitrary ownership.
gcs_contract.app_recorder: Separate provenance; forward-only stream cannot claim full duplex GCS command coverage.
gcs_contract.active_file: Prefix only until closure/content stability proven; do not force GCS disconnect.

comparison_contract.causality_policy: Observation and association distinct from controlled replicated support; no current-only PID advice.
comparison_contract.retained_hidden_fields: All calibration/learned/device-state values retained; only default focused view may collapse them.

identity_relationships.CaptureSession: contains many ArmedIntervals and concurrent background jobs
identity_relationships.FlightRecord: exactly one per ArmedInterval; FlightSession is legacy alias
identity_relationships.ParameterCapture: acquisition generation -> immutable ParameterSnapshot via snapshot_id
identity_relationships.ParameterProposal: unapplied candidate -> baseline snapshot; not actual-flight evidence
identity_relationships.ArtifactAssociation: many-to-many file spans attached to specific FlightRecord/ArmedInterval
identity_relationships.RetrievalRequest: missing source for a specific FlightRecord/ArmedInterval
identity_relationships.MetricResult_Finding: must retain manifest revision and effective-configuration interval links or explicit unknown eligibility
